proof_body:
by
  intro a ha
  have hne : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz h
    have h1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
    have h2 : ‖a‖ * ‖z‖ = 1 := by
      have := congrArg norm h1
      simpa using this
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg z]
  have id : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z‖ ^ 2 - ‖z - a‖ ^ 2 = (1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2) * (1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro z
    simp only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
    simp
    ring
  have ha2 : 0 < 1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg a]
  constructor
  · intro z hz
    have hn := hne z hz.le
    have hp : 0 < ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hn
    rw [norm_div, div_lt_one hp]
    have hz2 : 0 < 1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
    have := id z
    have h3 : 0 < (1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2) * (1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2) := mul_pos ha2 hz2
    have h4 : ‖z - a‖ ^ 2 < ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z‖ ^ 2 := by linarith
    exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 hp.le h4
  · intro z hz
    have hn := hne z hz.le
    have hp : 0 < ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hn
    rw [norm_div, div_eq_one_iff_eq hp.ne']
    have := id z
    rw [hz] at this
    have h4 : ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z‖ ^ 2 = ‖z - a‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact ((pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).mp h4).symm
target_source: ∀ (a : ℂ), ‖a‖ < 1 → (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < 1 → ‖(z - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z)‖ < 1) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖(z - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z)‖ = 1)
